title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

title: Sabrina
description: Sons (Harrison Ford, Greg Kinnear) of a Long Island tycoon become romantic rivals for the chauffeur's daughter (Julia Ormond).

title: Like Water for Chocolate
description: The youngest daughter (Lumi Cavazos) of a Mexican family expresses her feelings in preparing wonderful food, when tradition keeps her from marrying her true love (Marco Leonardi).

title: Ask the Dust
description: In Depression-era Los Angeles, a fiery Mexican waitress (Salma Hayek) who wants to improve her lot through marriage meets an aspiring writer (Colin Farrell) of Italian descent.

title: Piranha
description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

title: Nancy Drew
description: Accompanying her father on a business trip to Hollywood, the young sleuth (Emma Roberts) investigates the long-unsolved death of a movie star.

title: Congo
description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: The Relic
description: A grieving mother who thinks her child is reaching out to her from beyond holds a seance to communicate and unwittingly unleashes evil in her home.

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: The English Patient
description: A Hungarian count's (Ralph Fiennes) fling with a British newlywed leads to tragedy in World War II North Africa.

title: No Country for Old Men
description: An aging lawman (Tommy Lee Jones) reflects on his past and laments a changing world while trying to find and protect a hunter who took the cash from a drug deal gone bad.

title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
description: A blundering Los Angeles detective (Leslie Nielsen) and his boss (George Kennedy) foil a plan to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
description: Frank (Leslie Nielsen) and Ed (George Kennedy) of "Police Squad" blunder through another case, an energy-related plot in Washington, D.C.

title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
description: Ed (George Kennedy) coaxes his "Police Squad" pal Frank (Leslie Nielsen) out of retirement to thwart a terrorist bombing.

title: Dead Man Walking
description: A nun helps a double murderer deal with his actions and prepare for his execution in a New Orleans prison.

title: Indecent Proposal
description: A Las Vegas mystery man (Robert Redford) offers a desperate couple (Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson) $1 million for a night with the wife.

title: Free Birds
description: Two turkeys (Owen Wilson, Woody Harrelson) travel back in time to the year 1621 to prevent all feathered friends from ever becoming holiday dinners.

title: Best in Show
description: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

title: Million Dollar Baby
description: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing.

title: Proof
description: A depressed woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) copes with the death of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a brilliant but mentally ill mathematician.

title: The Score
description: A master thief (Robert De Niro) agrees to work with a volatile partner (Edward Norton) for one last heist before he retires.

title: A Perfect Murder
description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

title: Double Jeopardy
description: In an insurance scam, a man fakes his death and sets his wife up to take the blame. After serving 10 years in prison, she sets out to get revenge, immune from the law since she cannot be re-prosecuted for the same crime.

title: The Haunting
description: A parapsychologist and three others stay in a house reputed to be the site of many awful tragedies and paranormal events.

title: The Lovely Bones
description: A 14-year-old murder victim watches from heaven, as her family tries to heal and her killer continues on his own dark path.

title: Paranormal Activity
description: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night.

title: The November Man
description: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey).

title: Don Jon
description: A New Jersey bartender (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) embarks on his first genuine relationship with a woman (Scarlett Johansson), but his constant craving for Internet porn threatens to bring things crashing down.

title: Jenny's Wedding
description: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever.

title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
description: Emily Brontë's Cathy (Juliette Binoche) and Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) fuel two generations of gothic romance on the Yorkshire moors.

title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
description: In the future a cutting-edge android in the form of a boy (Haley Joel Osment) embarks on a journey to discover his true nature.

title: The Brothers Grimm
description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

title: Nancy Drew
description: Accompanying her father on a business trip to Hollywood, the young sleuth (Emma Roberts) investigates the long-unsolved death of a movie star.

title: The Perfect Score
description: High-school students (Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg) conspire to steal the answers to their upcoming SATs.

title: Big Night
description: Two Italian brothers hope to save their failing restaurant by preparing a feast for bandleader Louis Prima.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

title: Comet
description: A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower.

title: Nine
description: An Italian director (Daniel Day-Lewis) endures personal and creative crises as he tries to juggle relationships with his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz) and numerous other women.

title: The Doors
description: UCLA film student Jim Morrison (Val Kilmer) finds a girlfriend (Meg Ryan), forms a band and turns tragic 1960s rock star.

title: Hustle & Flow
description: A pimp (Terrence Howard) in Memphis, Tenn., sees rap music as the way to escape his dead-end existence and achieve something meaningful.

title: Like Water for Chocolate
description: The youngest daughter (Lumi Cavazos) of a Mexican family expresses her feelings in preparing wonderful food, when tradition keeps her from marrying her true love (Marco Leonardi).

title: Star Trek: Insurrection
description: To uphold the principles of his Starfleet oath and save an alien race, Capt. Picard defies Federation orders.

title: Election
description: Tracy faces no competition in her high school election, but the civics teacher intervenes by encouraging the varsity football player to run for president, resulting in chaos.

title: The Bodyguard
description: An ex-secret service agent falls for his client, an actress and singer someone wants dead before the Academy Awards.
